editorialDecl.p: Transcribed diplomatically from the page images of the copy named above, following the conventions of the commentary (DTA Base Format as customised for the edition): long s, umlauts with superscript e, the virgule as a comma, an “lb” at the beginning of every line, page and column breaks, running heads, signatures and catchwords as printed. Each entry of the Register is an “item”; the entries under one letter form a “list”. An entry that continues the preceding one (printed with a dash in place of the headword) is an item of its own. Headwords in bold Fraktur are marked “#b”, Antiqua “#aq”, italic Antiqua “#aq #i”. Two misprints are corrected with “choice” (erfuͤllee, nnd); other slips of the print are kept as printed (in in, wie wie, diatoniniſchen, ei- kleine for eine kleine).

The transcription has not yet been proofread against the print by a second person. Points to check: Academie (p. 465), “158. u. 160. z.”: the reading is clear, the meaning of “z.” is not. Gis moll (p. 471) and Solmiſation (p. 479) refer to p. 355, Sext und Quart (p. 478) to p. 315; the print reads so, but the passages are on p. 359 (Gis moll, solmiſiren) or not found (p. 315), so these are probably misprints of the Register. Page numbers outside the Ober-Classe (pp. 1–301) have not been checked against the text they refer to.
